name: BW11 SIM Smartwatch
subtitle: Calling, Camera and Fitness Tracking
description: BW11 is a smartwatch with SIM support, a built-in camera, Bluetooth connectivity, and an HD touchscreen. It tracks daily steps, distance, and calories, while music controls add convenient phone-connected functionality. The adjustable silicone strap completes its everyday wearable design.
story: The BW11 suits users who want essential smartwatch functions alongside the option of SIM-based calling. Its touchscreen provides access to watch features, while Bluetooth connectivity supports phone pairing and music control. Daily activity tracking covers steps, distance, and calories for routine movement monitoring. A built-in camera adds another on-wrist function for quick snapshots. The black watch body and adjustable silicone strap give it a straightforward design suitable for regular wear, whether used during everyday activities, travel, or casual outings.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
